question.text: If $a, b, c$ are in G.P. $(a>1, b>1, c>1)$, then for any real number $x($ with $x>0, x \neq 1), \log _{\mathrm{a}} x, \log _{\mathrm{b}} x, \log _{\mathrm{c}} x$ are in

solution.text:
Hints : $a, b, c$ are in G.P.
$\Rightarrow \log _x a, \log _x b, \log _x c$ are in A.P.
$\Rightarrow \frac{1}{\log _x a}, \frac{1}{\log _x b}, \frac{1}{\log _x c}$ arein H.P.
$\Rightarrow \log _a X, \log _b X, \log _c X$ are in H.P.
